name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.69

touch.notes: Touch is navigation-only and never approve/reject signing consent.

display.notes: 240x280 compact panel over SPI; the compact reference board for the universal esp32_usb_nip46 wallet firmware (nSealr Key).

approval_inputs.name: approve
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a physical control after exact board revision validation; touch-only approval remains disallowed.

approval_inputs.name: reject
approval_inputs.notes: Map to a different physical control after exact board revision validation.

wireless_policy: Wi-Fi/BLE must not participate in signing approval or request transport for the USB wallet MVP; signing transport is USB-only in v1.
debug_policy: Debug access stays enabled for board bring-up and must be locked before any production-key experiment.
production_signing: disabled until display, physical controls, storage, provisioning, and signing tests pass
reference_notes: Compact-role board of the curated Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch wallet family for the universal esp32_usb_nip46 firmware.
The ST7789V2 + CST816 combination is also the reference external panel for the custom-wallet display-agnostic FPC registry.
